exclusions: Initial fixture build ran out of disk space before executing a test. It is not runtime red evidence. A later retry failed to start its shell redirection before cleanup.
Only completed tablet DerivedData was removed. Its external xcresult bundles, logs and committed captures remain.
Initial tablet green attempt failed to find the catalog because the adaptive sidebar was collapsed. Explicit Show Sidebar navigation fixes the test; production sources remained unchanged.

Unsigned Mac UI launcher produced no test-start output for over four minutes and was interrupted. Local ad hoc retry failed to overwrite its generated test binary. Regenerating that runner resolves linking and signing, but the fresh retry again produces no test-start output and was interrupted. The startup cause is not established; zero Mac UI functions are qualified.

review.spec: No confirmed correctness regression. Pending native qualification and broader Q52 cases retained.
